description: This Java source file defines the `Bouncer` activity for an Android app, including a nested custom view class `MyView` that performs an animated bouncing shape using `ValueAnimator`. The file includes implementation details for animation setup, drawing, and user interaction.

classes.name: Bouncer
classes.description: Main activity class for the bouncing shape demo, sets the content view.

classes.name: Bouncer.MyView
classes.description: Custom view that displays a bitmap shape and animates its vertical position upon user interaction.

methods.name: Bouncer.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap resource, initializes shape dimensions, and sets click listener to start animation.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.setShapeX
methods.description: Updates the shape's X position and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.setShapeY
methods.description: Updates the shape's Y position and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.onSizeChanged
methods.description: Centers the shape horizontally when the view size changes.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at the current shape position.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts the value animator to animate the shape.

methods.name: Bouncer.MyView.getValueAnimator
methods.description: Creates a ValueAnimator that animates from 0 to 1 and updates shape Y position.
